note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase / PSNProfiles, cross-checked). Guides are written for this entry in my own words; every specific fact cites its source, and anything not yet confirmed is marked Unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the roadmap in order and it will be the last trophy you earn. The full list is 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze, all single-player — there are no online trophies at launch.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end — it is the first story mission and the trophy unlocks automatically when it finishes. Nothing here can be missed; just follow the on-screen objectives.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, tracked on the game's own checklist — use that checklist as the authority, not any website. Community checklists put the bar at 70 of 80 challenges, all 42 shooting-range golds, 100 WAiNK locations and the rest of the collectibles, and early community numbers are still being corrected, so check the in-game numbers as you go. This is the longest grind in the game: around 200 hours for the platinum in total.

trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The two ranges community guides name are Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Community guides count 18 spots at 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts twice, so bring your partner every time. THE MISSABLE ONE: the first meditation happens on the balcony of Jason's house in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her out to the balcony and accept. It disappears after Chapter 1 ends. Whether it strictly counts toward the trophy is still unconfirmed, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
